system.description:
You quickly improve the blood flow to your heart, briefly granting you heightened reaction speed and survivability. Until the start of your next turn, increase your AC by +4, including against the triggering attack, and you have advantage on Constitution saving throws.

Blood Detonation. If you still take damage when casting this jutsu, your blood bubbles at the point of impact and fires a retaliatory spear of ichor at the triggering creature. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack against the triggering creature if they are within 60 feet. On a hit, you deal 3d10 necrotic damage.
